    SELECT 1
    FROM "AgentSessions" AS a

    END AND a."Status" <> 4 AND a."Status" <> 5)) OR ((c."TaskId" IS NOT NULL OR c."ConsumerKind" = 2 OR c."ConsumerKind" = 3) AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM "AgentTasks" AS a0
    WHERE CASE
        WHEN c."TaskId" IS NOT NULL THEN a0."Id" = c."TaskId"
        ELSE c."ConsumerKey" = 'task:' || replace(a0."Id"::text, '-', '')
    END AND a0."Status" <> 4 AND a0."Status" <> 5 AND a0."Status" <> 6)))
